# Ailerix — LLM and agent index
# https://ailerix.com

> Ailerix routes every LLM request through Jev task-family classification and an Artificial Analysis cost-per-task frontier walk. Public model id: ailerix/auto.

## Product

- Home (markdown): https://ailerix.com/ (Accept: text/markdown)
- Documentation (markdown): https://ailerix.com/docs (Accept: text/markdown)
- Task families (markdown): https://ailerix.com/models (Accept: text/markdown)
- Playground (markdown): https://ailerix.com/playground (Accept: text/markdown)
- Dashboard (markdown): https://ailerix.com/dashboard (Accept: text/markdown)

## API and specs

- OpenAPI 3.1: https://ailerix.com/openapi.json
- API catalog (RFC 9727): https://ailerix.com/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent authentication guide: https://ailerix.com/auth.md
- Human docs: https://ailerix.com/docs

## Agent protocols

- MCP server card: https://ailerix.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- A2A agent card: https://ailerix.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Agent skills index: https://ailerix.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- AI resource directory: https://ailerix.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json

## Primary operations

- Chat completions: POST https://ailerix.com/api/v1/chat/completions
- Route preview: POST https://ailerix.com/api/v1/route
- Models list: GET https://ailerix.com/api/v1/models
- Generation lookup: GET https://ailerix.com/api/v1/generation?id=
- Analytics summary: GET https://ailerix.com/api/v1/analytics/summary
- API key info: GET https://ailerix.com/api/v1/key
- MCP (streamable HTTP): https://ailerix.com/api/mcp
